- Create a workspace.
- Invite members by email.
- Shared notes in a workspace.
- Two roles only: admin and member.

- Billing changes.
- SSO.
- Guest access.
Build only the features listed under "in"; do not add others.

Format: a standard PRD template, about 2 pages. Choose the sections yourself (for example overview, problem, goals and metrics, users and roles, requirements, scope in and out, open questions, gaps and assumptions). Keep each section short enough to fit the length.

Mark anything you had to assume, in a short "Assumptions" list inside the doc, separate from the evidence gaps.

Reply with the PRD only. Nothing follows it.
